title: Chapter 269 Chang Gui Changes His Job To Priest
content:
Chapter 269 Chang Gui Changes His Job To Priest

After a while, a wooden man in a Taoist robe took shape.

[Chang Gui]

[Level: Level 59 (Sacrifice) (Physique: Wooden Man)]

[Attack Power: 100]

[Defense Power: 50]

[Life Points: 4000]

[Skills: Pray, Summon Wooden Man, Life Healing, Immunity. ]

Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows when he saw this attribute.

This kid is actually at level 59, and he has several skills. He is quite impressive!

"A Gui, tell me honestly, what level were you before?"

"Lord, in my current recovered memory, I am at this level!"

"Then how much memory do you have not recovered."

"I don't know."

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank suddenly.

"Maybe there are still memories that have not been recovered, or maybe there are none."

"Then tell me carefully, what are the uses of these skills of yours."

Chang Gui briefly described.

Praying can consume certain sacrifices. If you make a wish, there is a certain chance of it coming true. The chance of the wish coming true is proportional to the simplicity.

Summoning wooden men can summon 4 wooden men of the same level to fight for him.

Life healing can be regarded as a skill that increases life value.

And immunity is even more awesome.

Not only for himself, but also for others to release skills. To a certain extent, it is immune to attacks, including physical, skills, toxicity, etc.

Wang Shuo was very happy.

He quickly checked his loyalty and found it was full, so he was relieved.

After three days of separation, Chang Gui has transformed into a senior talent.

At this time, Duan Wenxi walked in.

"Boss, there are many refugees coming now, wanting to enter our territory dungeon."

"Who are they?"

"Most of them are some lords, and there are a few gangs and mercenaries."

Wang Shuo rushed to the door of the dungeon.

At this time, many people have gathered.

"President, you promised us to let us enter the dungeon to level up."

Hearing this, Wang Shuo was secretly happy.

He took a look and found that it was a lord of Nanshan Society.

Wang Shuo smiled and nodded.

There are fewer and fewer monsters in the wild now, and most players have no place to level up.

Originally, there were many dungeons in the wild, but some of them were opened by players and disappeared.

There are also some dungeons that are too difficult to handle for small forces.

Some are occupied by some lords and are not allowed to be touched by others.

The monsters in the dungeons that are not completely controlled by the players have a very slow refresh time, while Wang Shuo's dungeons can basically achieve unlimited monster refresh.

Many lords of Nanshan Society are envious.

The level of the territory army is closely related to the combat effectiveness!

Seeing the level of the army in Wang Shuo's territory, they are envious.

Wang Shuo saw everyone's eagerness and said with a smile: "You can enter the dungeon. As you know, fighting inside will cause losses."

"Lord Wang, just tell me directly, how much does this cost?"

Wang Shuo glanced at the boy, he was very sensible!

"Since everyone is mainly for the level, then killing monsters will no longer drop items. One hour per person, 10 energy crystals."

After Wang Shuo finished speaking, the scene suddenly fell into silence.

Many people thought it was a bit expensive.

What if the monsters inside are too strong and they can't kill them, or they have to walk a long way to see a monster, then it's a big loss.

Wang Shuo probably thought of everyone's concerns, and then said: "Don't worry, there are monsters of all levels inside, and they will refresh very frequently, and they will definitely kill you until you are weak."

"But there is one thing, entering the dungeon, life and death are at your own risk. If you don't do it within your ability, you can't blame me if you die!"
